name: The Drowned Tollbridge
description:
West of the square, the cathedral causeway drops to a three-arched bridge of black basalt spanning a subterranean river. The water has risen over the lower embankments, flooding the toll-plaza ankle-deep in slow, ink-black current. Heavy quarantine chains and a dropped iron floodgate bar the far arch toward the deeper warrens.

Beside the central toll-post stands a flooded stone guardhouse, its lintel stamped with the iron flame of the Ashen Order's Third Expeditionary Patrol.
revisit: Black canal water eddies ankle-deep across the basalt flagstones of the Drowned Tollbridge.

variants.text: Beyond a line of rusted iron studs, a figure in waterlogged plate waits motionless in the toll-arch, his halberd barred across the span and the stolen beacon-lens locked inside an iron cage on the toll-post.
Toll-Warden Garin rests against the basalt parapet with his visor raised and his halberd planted upright beside the floodgate, his quarantine watch finally ended.
Rusted plate and broken pike-shafts lie half-submerged in the black water across the bridge.
The Smoked-Glass Beacon Lens waits inside the unlatched iron cage on the toll-post.

ambient: Black water eddies around the basalt piers with a cold, hollow gurgle.
A rusted quarantine chain swings beneath the arch, clinking softly against wet stone.
The smell of river-silt, wet iron, and old lamp-oil hangs heavy under the bridge vault.
Ripples catch your light and throw pale, shivering rings across the underside of the arches.

exits.description: The flooded causeway climbs back east toward the Lantern Market of Nocturne.

features.name: toll-line
features.description: A line of rusted iron studs crosses the flooded flagstones at the foot of the central arch. Beyond it, Toll-Warden Garin stands in the black water with his halberd barred across the span, as still as if he has not moved in years.

interactions.label: Step up to the toll-line and face Toll-Warden Garin
interactions.text: You wade forward until the black water swirls around the rusted studs of the toll-line.

features.name: far arch
features.description: Past the central toll-post, the third arch of the bridge ends at a dropped iron floodgate hung with quarantine chains. Beyond its bars the canal tunnels on into the dark, toward the deeper warrens of the Under-Barrow.

interactions.label: Cross the tollbridge into the deeper warrens
interactions.text: You set your shoulder to the rusted winch. Chain by groaning chain, the floodgate lifts out of the black water, and the far arch opens onto a tunnel that breathes cold air and older silence.

then.text: Garin wades over and takes the other spoke of the wheel without a word. When the gate is high enough, he plants his halberd upright in the silt and raises a gauntlet to his brow as you pass.

features.name: iron lens-cage
features.description: An iron quarantine cage bolted to the stone toll-post. Inside rests the curved Smoked-Glass Beacon Lens pried from Nocturne's central beacon.

interactions.label: Take the Smoked-Glass Beacon Lens
interactions.text: You lift the Smoked-Glass Beacon Lens from the open iron cage. Through its curved dark crystal, the Barrowlight's flame splits into three steady rings: sun, moon, and skull.

features.name: sunken guardhouse
features.description: The lower guardhouse beside the bridge is half-swallowed by black canal water. Behind the rusted floodgate winch, an iron patrol chest sits wedged between two stone steps.

interactions.label: Haul up the patrol chest from the sunken guardhouse
interactions.text: You wade into the freezing black water of the guardhouse and brace your boot against the stone step to heave at the wedged iron chest.

success.text: With a sucking groan of river-silt, the chest comes free. Inside, wrapped in oiled leather against the damp, lies an Ashen Censer-Mace and twenty silver coins from the patrol's pay-box.

failure.text: The iron chest is wedged fast in the freezing silt, and the black water numbs your hands before you can work it loose.

features.name: floodgate memory echo
features.description: In the Barrowlight's beam, the mist over the floodgate winches thickens into the phantom of an armored captain straining at the iron wheel while fists hammer from the flooded tunnel beyond.

interactions.label: Shine the Barrowlight on the floodgate echo
interactions.text:
You hold the Barrowlight toward the winch, and the wet stone replays the night the river rose.

"Garin, open the grate!" voices shout from the dark behind the iron bars, choking on black water. "We're still alive in here!"

The phantom of Toll-Warden Garin clings to the wheel, trembling. "I can't! If the flood breaks through, the whole square drowns! I'll bring a lantern back for you—I swear on the ash I'll come back!"

npcs.name: Toll-Warden Garin
npcs.description: Toll-Warden Garin leans against the basalt parapet with his visor raised, his hollow eyes fixed on the calm black water beyond the floodgate.

encounter.intro:
Water splashes beneath heavy boots as a figure in mud-blackened Ashen plate steps out from the toll-arch, levelling a rusted halberd at your chest. Beside the bridge pilings, a drowned lancer drags itself up out of the canal, black water pouring from its gorget.

"Halt at the line!" Toll-Warden Garin barks, his voice echoing hollowly inside his helm as though he has shouted the same words a thousand times to an empty bridge. On the post behind him glints the curved smoked-glass lens pried from Nocturne's beacon. "By order of the Ashen Tribunal, this crossing is under quarantine! No light passes! No waking thing crosses the water!"

options.label: Tell him the flood has passed and forgive the promise he could not keep to his patrol
Present the Ferryman's Obol and claim lawful passage across the threshold
Speak as an Oath-Eater who knows when a tribunal's order has become a lie
Show him the Elders' Writ and formally discharge the Third Patrol's arrears
Show him the scored signet and relieve his watch in the name of the fallen

onSuccess.text:
Garin flinches as though struck. Slowly, he reaches up and lifts his rusted visor. Beneath it, his face is grey with river-silt and old tears.

"I dropped the grate so the flood wouldn't take the square," he whispers, looking down at the lancer in the water beside him. "I told them I'd come back with a lantern to open it. And then the tribunal's orders came in my head, over and over, until I forgot why I took the lens at all." He lowers his halberd and unlatches the iron cage on the post. Beside the pier, the drowned lancer sinks quietly back beneath the black water. "Take the lens. Let them have the light I owed them."

onFailure.text: "No exceptions!" Garin roars, his voice scraping like iron on stone. "The contagion stays below the grate!"

onVictory.text: Toll-Warden Garin crashes to his knees in the black water, his halberd snapping against the flagstones as the drowned lancer slips lifelessly beneath the current. On the toll-post, the iron cage holding the stolen lens swings open.
